title: After Novartis’ devastating M&A losses, long live the executive willing to try
snippet: Big Pharma needs more—not fewer—bold bets on rare and difficult diseases after Novartis’ efforts to invest in muscular dystrophy and ALS hit major roadblocks this month.

title: Multi-Omics Analysis and Experimental Validation Uncover Neddylation-Associated Biomarkers and Cellular Landscape in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
snippet: Accumulating evidence suggests that neddylation contributes to tumor initiation and progression. Nonetheless, its biological functions and regulatory mechanisms in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) remain poorly understood.
